properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-constant-time string comparisons in JavaScript code (amp-autocomplete, amp-iframe, etc.) that use === operator instead of timing-safe comparison functions, which can leak information through timing attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA signature verification in AMP extensions (amp-a4a, amp-access) using RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256 hash - this is a quantum vulnerability that needs migration to ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT tokens signed with RS256 are used in AMP ad verification systems and access control. These are classical RSA signatures that would be vulnerable to quantum attacks under Shor's algorithm, requiring migration to ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.
